newsitem.title: KENYA: Rates on Kenya's main category of T-bills lower.
newsitem.headline: Rates on Kenya's main category of T-bills lower.

text.p: Kenya's 91-day main category of treasury bills were seen lower on Friday at next Thursday's weekly auction, the Central Bank of Kenya said on Friday.

The bank said it accepted bids at an average yield of 21.575 percent from 21.604 percent on the main category of bills while in the 28-day category of bills, the bank accepted bids at an unchanged yield of 16.500 percent.

Out of a total of 6.630 billion shillings tendered, the bank accepted 6.348 billion shillings. Some 16.90 million shillings were accepted in the 28-day category while 6.331 billion shillings were accepted in the 91-day category.
The bank said there were no tenders for the 182-day category.
The central bank invited tenders for treasury bills worth 10 billion shillings for next week's auction on Thursday.
